points.en: PM-KISAN: Central sector scheme launched in 2019 providing Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to landholding farmer families.
points.hi: PM-KISAN: Central sector scheme launched in 2019 providing Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to landholding farmer families.

points.en: Objective: To supplement financial needs of farmers in procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields.
points.hi: Objective: To supplement financial needs of farmers in procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields.

points.en: Exclusions: Income tax payers, institutional landholders, and high-ranking officials are excluded from PM-KISAN benefits.
points.hi: Exclusions: Income tax payers, institutional landholders, and high-ranking officials are excluded from PM-KISAN benefits.

points.en: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana): Comprehensive crop insurance scheme offering low premium rates (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops).
points.hi: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana): Comprehensive crop insurance scheme offering low premium rates (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops).

points.en: KCC (Kisan Credit Card): Provides adequate and timely credit support from the banking system to farmers for cultivation and other needs.
points.hi: KCC (Kisan Credit Card): Provides adequate and timely credit support from the banking system to farmers for cultivation and other needs.

points.en: Interest Subvention Scheme: Provides short-term crop loans up to Rs. 3 lakh at subsidized interest rates.
points.hi: Interest Subvention Scheme: Provides short-term crop loans up to Rs. 3 lakh at subsidized interest rates.

points.en: AIF (Agriculture Infrastructure Fund): Financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
points.hi: AIF (Agriculture Infrastructure Fund): Financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.

points.en: PM-AASHA: Umbrella scheme ensuring remunerative prices to farmers through Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment System (PDPS), and Pilot of Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPSS).
points.hi: PM-AASHA: Umbrella scheme ensuring remunerative prices to farmers through Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment System (PDPS), and Pilot of Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPSS).

points.en: Importance for UPSC GS-3: Focuses on doubling farmers' income, food security, and rural economic resilience.
points.hi: Importance for UPSC GS-3: Focuses on doubling farmers' income, food security, and rural economic resilience.

question.en: What is the financial allocation per year under the PM-KISAN scheme and who funds it?
question.hi: What is the financial allocation per year under the PM-KISAN scheme and who funds it?

answer.en: Rs. 6,000 per year paid in three 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each. It is 100% centrally funded by the Government of India.
answer.hi: Rs. 6,000 per year paid in three 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each. It is 100% centrally funded by the Government of India.

question.en: What are the uniform premium rates paid by farmers under PMFBY for Kharif and Rabi crops?
question.hi: What are the uniform premium rates paid by farmers under PMFBY for Kharif and Rabi crops?

answer.en: 2% of the sum insured for all Kharif crops and 1.5% for all Rabi crops. For commercial and horticultural crops, it is 5%.
answer.hi: 2% of the sum insured for all Kharif crops and 1.5% for all Rabi crops. For commercial and horticultural crops, it is 5%.

misconception.en: PM-KISAN provides income support only to tenant farmers and agricultural laborers.
misconception.hi: PM-KISAN provides income support only to tenant farmers and agricultural laborers.

correction.en: PM-KISAN is targeted at landholding farmer families based on land records, though state governments verify beneficiaries.
correction.hi: PM-KISAN is targeted at landholding farmer families based on land records, though state governments verify beneficiaries.

misconception.en: PMFBY is a mandatory scheme for all farmers across India.
misconception.hi: PMFBY is a mandatory scheme for all farmers across India.

correction.en: Enrollment in PMFBY has been made voluntary for all farmers, including loanee farmers, since the revamping in 2020.
correction.hi: Enrollment in PMFBY has been made voluntary for all farmers, including loanee farmers, since the revamping in 2020.

fiveFacts.en: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme with 100% funding from the Union Government.
fiveFacts.hi: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme with 100% funding from the Union Government.

fiveFacts.en: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) provides medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in post-harvest infrastructure.
fiveFacts.hi: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) provides medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in post-harvest infrastructure.

fiveFacts.en: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme was introduced in 1998–99 on the recommendations of the R.V. Gupta Committee.
fiveFacts.hi: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme was introduced in 1998–99 on the recommendations of the R.V. Gupta Committee.

fiveFacts.en: PM-AASHA integrates price support and price deficiency payment mechanisms to protect farmers from market price volatility.
fiveFacts.hi: PM-AASHA integrates price support and price deficiency payment mechanisms to protect farmers from market price volatility.

fiveFacts.en: Interest subvention scheme provides prompt repayment incentives, lowering effective interest rates on short-term crop loans.
fiveFacts.hi: Interest subvention scheme provides prompt repayment incentives, lowering effective interest rates on short-term crop loans.

threeTraps.en: Assuming all agricultural laborers are covered under direct income support like PM-KISAN without land ownership.

threeTraps.en: Confusing Central Sector Schemes (100% central funding) with Centrally Sponsored Schemes (shared funding between Centre and States).
